description: The day's-end hint pointing to the captain's bed has been shown.
The morning after the prologue: Story Phase 2 has begun.
Blackbeard caught Barnacle Bob trying to drink lamp oil.
The captain walked forward of the main hatch on the first morning.
One-Eyed Ned called out the object off the starboard bow.
Blackbeard looked through the telescope at the man in the bathtub.
Garrick has been pulled aboard from his bathtub.
Captain Squawks has returned and met Garrick (mutual dislike).
Blackbeard has questioned Garrick about his qualifications.
Garrick is provisionally a member of the crew.
Garrick Grumblegut is aboard the Revenge.
Garrick has roped off the foredeck as 'Garrick's Toll Deck'.
Garrick shouted his toll-deck rates at the approaching captain.
Blackbeard made Garrick take down his toll deck.
Blackbeard caught Garrick 'supervising' the deck scrubbing.
Garrick has eaten his catastrophic lunch in the galley.
Garrick's stomach has begun making ominous noises.
Salty Jim has told the captain about the old sausages.
Garrick's stomach rumbled while 'helping' with the sails.
Garrick blamed the rumbling on distant thunder (chapter 2 done).
Blackbeard and Garrick have entered the treasure room together.
Garrick has seen the treasure (and dived into it).
Garrick has been searched and the valuables recovered.
Blackbeard has looked over the hoard after the swell.
Blackbeard and Garrick have moved the fallen chest.
The Grumblegut Gust has happened in the treasure room.
The yellow cloud is spreading through the ship.
Blackbeard has discovered the blast came from Garrick.
The crew's evacuation to the main deck has played.
Garrick has warned everyone about the Dead Center.
Squawks has been blown down the main hatch into the fumes.
Rook has tied a rescue line around the captain.
Doc Fennimore has given the captain a wet cloth.
The captain is roped up and masked for the rescue.
The captain is wearing the rescue rope and cloth.
Garrick warned that the fumes soak permanently into leather.
Blackbeard has caught Squawks in the Dead Center.
Squawks has been carried out of the fumes alive.
Squawks has lost nearly all his feathers.
Squawks is in the fumes (sooty, puffed, losing feathers).
The captain's boots are permanently stained.
The worst of the cloud has thinned to a haze below decks.
The treasure is permanently contaminated.
Blackbeard has seen the ruined treasure room.
Inspected: the contaminated gold.
Inspected: the pickled-onion ruby.
Inspected: the clouded crown.
Inspected: the sweating pearls.
Inspected: the chest Garrick landed on.
Inspected: the stained planks.
Blackbeard has taken a chest to the prisoner merchant.
Penhallow refused even one coin of the treasure.
The odour has bonded with the ship. Permanently.
The crew drew weapons on Garrick.
Evening: Garrick's trial has begun.
Squawks wears a knitted sweater and cap.
A royal navy frigate has interrupted the trial.
Blackbeard agreed to Garrick's plan to use the fouled sail.
The Revenge has been brought upwind of the frigate.
The contaminated sail has been released at the frigate.
The frigate has fled in disarray.
Garrick remains aboard under strict probation.
The crew's rowboat protocol for stomach noises is in force.
Squawks has started shouting DEADLY BREW as a warning.
Story Phase 2 (Garrick and the Cursed Treasure) is complete.
Salty Jim has said good morning on the first day.
Penhallow has introduced himself (and complained).
The galley crew fled the Gust (cutaway).
The crew quarters emptied during the Gust (cutaway).
